title: Time bound for the unary generator
statement: For all natural numbers $c,C$, the unary generator computes the function that sends each Boolean word $x$ to a word of $C(|x|+1)^{c+1}$ ones within $(C+5(c+1)+4)(|x|+1)^{c+1}$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: The input is any Boolean word
replaced:
For all parameters $c$ and $C$, the unary polynomial generator computes the
function sending a word of length $n$ to the run of $C\,(n+1)^{c+1}$ ones,
within $(C + 5(c+1) + 4)\,(n+1)^{c+1}$ steps; this covers coefficient $C = 0$
and empty input.
